title: GarageBand reverse-engineering progress
scope_note: Rough estimate of targeted format knowledge recovered, not a measure of converter completeness. Category weights express project priorities; category percentages are evidence-based judgments. The headline rounds the weighted estimate to the nearest 10%.

categories.name: Package and summary metadata
categories.basis: ZIP inventory and plist summary fields are parsed; metadata authority and cross-version differences remain open.

categories.name: Logic payload framing and event inventory
categories.basis: Chunk/event boundaries validated across fixtures; MIDI-030 inventories 304 records in uniquely placed MIDI groups and IDA confirms representative ranges. Most event semantics remain open.

categories.name: Audio references and placement starts
categories.basis: A second cached arrangement preview agrees with the parsed audio placement starts and row order; absolute indices, loop-cell role, and duration remain unknown.

categories.name: Region lengths, trims, loops, and offsets
categories.basis: ARR-040 found two distinct, duplicated AuRg frame pairs in one source whose sums equal its CAF frame count; offset/trim meaning remains hypothetical.

categories.name: MIDI placement and note semantics
categories.basis: Preview matches candidate onset and pitch order in two rows; MIDI-038 adds serialized-order and distinct-pitch shared-onset correlations in one fixture. Absolute semantics remain open.

categories.name: Tempo and meter timeline
categories.basis: Summary and unique group-zero tempo/meter candidates agree in two projects; position units, change maps, and completeness remain unresolved.

categories.name: Tracks, mixer, sections, and automation
categories.basis: Trak links and ordinal agreement support provisional MIDI bindings; identity, names, mixer state and automation remain unresolved.

milestones.name: Audio source and start recovery
milestones.state: partial: parsed audio placement starts agree with cached arrangement previews in two projects; absolute indices and cell placement remain unresolved

milestones.name: MIDI interpretation
milestones.state: partial: preview supports fixture-specific onset and pitch candidates; one fixture also has nondecreasing serialized onsets and distinct-pitch shared-onset groups; controlled validation remains open

milestones.name: Region boundaries and track state
milestones.state: partial: MIDI extent candidates and an AuRg source-frame window relation; duration, trim/repeat/stretch and track state unconfirmed

milestones.name: FL Studio output
milestones.state: experimental: Synthetic MIDI notes are editable in FL Studio 25 and source-matched WAV clips load; playback and other versions remain unverified.
